issues: Sheets 1-13: the whole video is the same static burette box and acid box on a mostly empty lower half of the frame; no visual ever shows liquid, color, swirling or a pink that lingers, so the lesson is told only by text.
Sheet 9-10: the key idea (faint pink) is a tiny gold label in a box that replaces the acid box; there is no pink color anywhere, so the viewer never sees what the endpoint looks like.
Sheet 11-12: a stray gold '0' appears out of nowhere at about 21.9 s and sits there with no label; it presumably stands for the 30-second hold but is unreadable and meaningless, and it never counts.
Sheet 6-8: 'pink' is a small grey word beside the box that fades; the flash and fade of pink on swirl is not animated, so the contrast between fleeting and lingering pink is lost.

Sheets 1-13: the on-screen headline lags and differs from the captions (headline says 'Sodium hydroxide, from the burette' while caption says 'drips'), and headline text changes in crossfades that overlap the old text (sheets 2, 4, 9, 10), so the eye is split between title and caption.
Sheet 1-13: the big chalk headline is a rewording of the narration, duplicating the caption below; captions are small, thin-looking and sit far from the subject.
Sheet 13: the final burette outline thickens and the video ends on 'Then read the volume' with no volume reading shown, no payoff and no hold on the endpoint.
Sheet 1 and 3: the 'acid + phenolphthalein' label is small, low-contrast chalk text inside a box, hard to read on a phone.
